## Goal

Track everything required before the **first public release** of Pulse (`v0.1.0`).

This issue is the single checklist for going public. Do **not** mark the repository public until this list is complete (or consciously deferred with notes).

---

## Installer

- [ ] `Pulse-Setup-*-windows-x64.exe` builds reproducibly via `package_beta.ps1`
- [ ] Clean uninstall → reinstall works on a fresh Windows 10/11 VM
- [ ] UAC elevation + VC++ redist path verified
- [ ] PulseService auto-start / stay-up after reboot
- [ ] Code signing plan documented (or explicitly deferred)
- [ ] GitHub Release draft prepared (assets, notes, version tags)

## Timeline

- [ ] Initial snapshot (~100 events) loads automatically on Connected — no Retry required
- [ ] Startup order deterministic: ServerHello → TimelineSnapshot → StartLiveMonitoring
- [ ] Search / severity / source filters work on historical + live events
- [ ] JSON export works
- [ ] Empty / offline / error states are clear and recoverable

## Live Monitoring

- [ ] Live subscribe starts only after snapshot completes
- [ ] Page-visibility pause / resume behaves correctly
- [ ] Settings toggle for live monitoring persists and applies
- [ ] No duplicate events flooding the Timeline under normal load

## System Health

- [ ] CPU / memory / GPU / disk / network cards populate when connected
- [ ] Offline empty states when PulseService is down
- [ ] No PulseService crash under LocalService during health sampling
- [ ] Values are plausible vs Task Manager (spot-check)

## Diagnostics

- [ ] Diagnostics snapshot shows service / IPC / pipeline fields
- [ ] Inject test event appears on Timeline
- [ ] Diagnostics export zip opens and contains expected files
- [ ] No sensitive user paths/secrets leaked in default export

## Settings

- [ ] Welcome / onboarding skippable and remembered
- [ ] Preferences persist across restart
- [ ] Compact mode / animations toggles apply without breaking layout

## Documentation

- [ ] README reflects current version, status, and install path
- [ ] BUILD.md / DEVELOPMENT.md match the installer workflow
- [ ] Architecture docs / ADRs up to date for shipped v1 scope
- [ ] SECURITY.md contact path confirmed for public release
- [ ] LICENSE copyright line finalized

## Website

- [ ] Landing page copy + hero screenshot
- [ ] Download CTA points at GitHub Releases
- [ ] Privacy statement (local-first, no telemetry)
- [ ] Link from README

## Demo Video

- [ ] Short demo (install → Connected → Timeline snapshot → live event)
- [ ] System Health walkthrough clip or segment
- [ ] Hosted link ready for README / Product Hunt

## Product Hunt assets

- [ ] Gallery images (Timeline, Health, Diagnostics, Settings)
- [ ] Tagline + first-comment draft
- [ ] Maker account / launch date plan

## Final QA

- [ ] Fresh VM: install → use → uninstall → reinstall
- [ ] IPC smoke (`pulse_ipc_ping`) + Flutter tests green on CI
- [ ] No known release-blocking bugs open
- [ ] Private → public readiness review (secrets, tokens, internal paths scrubbed)
- [ ] Explicit maintainer approval to publish the repository / release

---

## Notes

- Product constitution: `AGENTS.md` (observation-only)
- Current packaging version at checklist creation: `0.1.0-beta.3`
